roleInfo.name: Employee
roleInfo.description: Delegate dreaded tasks. Don't end up with 4 of any one on your desk!

Default.welcomeText: Delegate dreaded tasks face-down and lie about what they are. Get stuck with 4 of the same task on your desk and you're BURIED. Last ones standing win!
Default.tutorialVoteQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.stuckText: ($1) has nothing left to delegate. Everyone else wins!
Default.pickTaskPrompt: ($1), pick a task to delegate (kept face-down).
Default.decideText: Decide: True, Bluff, or Peek & Pass.
Default.decisionPromptNoPeek: ($1): everyone has seen it — True or Bluff?
Default.buriedText: Four ($1)s on one desk. Everyone else wins!
Default.claimAndDumpText: Now claim what you like and dump it on someone new.
Default.winnerText: The buck stopped with someone else.
